entries.en: The circuit used a discriminator to separate the signals.
entries.zh: 电路使用鉴别器分离信号。

entries.en: The pest-control archive listed warfarin among its older rodenticides.
entries.zh: 害虫防治档案把杀鼠灵列在较早使用的灭鼠剂中。

entries.en: Excessive heat can denature the protein in the sample.
entries.zh: 过高的温度会使样本中的蛋白质变性。

entries.en: The workshop can recondition the old pump.
entries.zh: 这家作坊能修复旧水泵。

entries.en: The unimproved land remained covered in scrub.
entries.zh: 未经改良的土地仍被灌木覆盖。

entries.en: Such a journey was scarcely thinkable before the bridge opened.
entries.zh: 桥开通之前，这样的旅程几乎难以想象。

entries.en: The declaration promised enfranchisement from foreign rule.
entries.zh: 宣言许诺摆脱外国统治而获得解放。

entries.en: The vessel completed its circumnavigation after three years.
entries.zh: 那艘船三年后完成了环球航行。

entries.en: The experiment added an inducer to activate the target gene.
entries.zh: 实验加入了一种诱导物来激活目标基因。

entries.en: The diver photographed a flat-bodied monkfish on the seabed.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍下了海床上一条身体扁平的扁鲨。

entries.en: The haberdasher displayed ties in the window.
entries.zh: 男装经销商在橱窗里展示了领带。

entries.en: The newspaper reproduced the photograph as a halftone.
entries.zh: 报纸把那张照片制成网版图像刊印。
